title: Spectral Steering: Local Inverse Geometry for Frozen Diffusion Generators
abstract: arXiv:2611.19572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A frozen diffusion generator may need to change several output properties while preserving others. We study when guidance faithfully realizes such a structured request and whether local inverse correction improves its direction. Our account links this benefit to the interaction between the request and the objective-specific remaining-sampler Jacobian: conditioning alone is insufficient. Spectral steering combines a request-specific cosine-gain predictor with damped inverse correction and fixed-time relinearization for finite edits. Scalar nulls and matched-movement controls test the predicted mechanism. Across 8,923 instances in a retrospectively identified local regime, predicted and realized gains correlate at Spearman 0.79, versus -0.11 for condition number. Experiments span images, audio, robotics, and control and planning, including complex character motion generation. On 50 paired inpainting cases, four corrections improve unobse

translated_title: 谱导向：冻结扩散生成器的局部逆几何
translated_abstract: 冻结的扩散生成器可能需要在保留其他属性的同时改变若干输出属性。我们研究了引导（guidance）何时能忠实地实现这种结构化请求，以及局部逆修正能否改善其方向。我们的理论将这一收益与请求和目标特定的剩余采样器雅可比矩阵之间的相互作用联系起来：仅靠条件化是不够的。谱导向方法将针对特定请求的余弦增益预测器与阻尼逆修正以及用于有限编辑的固定时间重线性化相结合。标量零空间与匹配运动对照实验检验了所预测的机制。在回溯性确定的局部区域内，跨8,923个实例，预测增益与实际实现增益的Spearman相关系数达0.79，而条件数仅为-0.11。实验涵盖图像、音频、机器人以及控制与规划领域，包括复杂的人物动作生成。在50个配对图像修复案例中，四次修正改善了未观……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出谱导向方法，通过结合请求特定的余弦增益预测器、阻尼逆修正与固定时间重线性化，使冻结扩散生成器能够可靠地实现“改变部分输出属性同时保留其余属性”的结构化编辑请求，在8,923个实例上预测增益与实际增益的Spearman相关性达0.79，显著优于传统条件数指标。
en_tdlr: Proposes spectral steering, which combines a request-specific cosine-gain predictor with damped inverse correction and fixed-time relinearization, enabling frozen diffusion generators to reliably realize structured edit requests that change some output properties while preserving others, with predicted and realized gains correlating at Spearman 0.79 across 8,923 instances.
